title: Nourishing Gooey Dutch Potato Casserole
description: A hearty and comforting Dutch dish featuring pancetta and score-fat, perfect for a cold winter's night, this lacto-vegetarian-friendly casserole is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, cook the diced pancetta over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the pancetta from the pot and set aside, leaving the grease behind.
Add the chopped onions to the pot and cook until they are softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced potatoes to the pot, stirring to combine with the onions and garlic.
In a small bowl, combine the melted score-fat, heavy cream, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the score-fat mixture over the potatoes and onions in the pot.
Top the potatoes with the shredded gruyere cheese and cooked pancetta.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the casserole for 45 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown.
